body: I can confirm that 7.1.0 allows using "ignore_malformed" in templates for `keyword`type. However it already rejects the same parameter when directly used in a `keyword` type mapping. With 7.10 we issue a deprecation warning when putting the template, but we should avoid throwing this error for existing malformed templates when adding documents with new fields.

issue.title: Add bwc for parsing mappings from dynamic templates

labels.name: :Search Foundations/Mapping
labels.description: Index mappings, including merging and defining field types

repository.name: elasticsearch
repository.description: Free and Open Source, Distributed, RESTful Search Engine

issue.body:
During refactoring of the mapper parsing code, the part that checks for unknown
mapper parameters and throws an error when one is found was moved to
FieldMapper.Builder#parse which gets also executed when applying matching
dynamic templates. However, dynamic templates introduced during the 7.x versions
may still contain arbitrary parameters, although we have deprecation warnings
for that in place on latest 7.x now. When using these templates, indexing a new
document with a new field that triggers one of these mappings to be parsed can
create an error as demonstrated in #66765. Instead we need to be lenient in
these cases and simply ignore the unknown parameter while issuing a deprecation
warning here as well.

Closes #66765

issue.body:
**Elasticsearch version** (`bin/elasticsearch --version`):
Version: 7.10.2, Build: default/docker/747e1cc71def077253878a59143c1f785afa92b9/2021-01-13T00:42:12.435326Z, JVM: 15.0.1

**OS version** (`uname -a` if on a Unix-like system):
Linux elasticsearch-es-data-3 5.4.0-1025-aws #25-Ubuntu SMP Fri Sep 11 09:37:24 UTC 2020 x86_64 x86_64 x86_64 GNU/Linux

**Description of the problem including expected versus actual behavior**:
Having a dynamic template (legacy template) with certain fields to disable dynamic mapping does not work anymore and ends in: `unknown parameter [enabled] on mapper [xxx]`.

This was working before in 7.8.x.

This sounds related to:
* https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/64982
* https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/66765

**Steps to reproduce**:

index template:
```json
[
  {
    "default_no_index": {
      "match_pattern": "regex",
      "path_match": "^.*$",
      "path_unmatch": "^(@timestamp|auditID|level|stage|requestURI|sourceIPs|metadata|objectRef|user|verb)(\\..+)?$",
      "mapping": {
        "index": false,
        "enabled": "false"
      }
    }
  }
]
```

First document to a new index applied ends in:
```json
{"took":13,"errors":true,"items":[{"index":{"_index":"k8saudit-2021.02.04","_type":"_doc","_id":"hxzGbHcB1FB4PL8e-t_M","status":400,"error":{"type":"mapper_parsing_exception","reason":"unknown parameter [enabled] on mapper [kind] of type [null]"}}},{"index":{"_index":"k8saudit-2021.02.04","_type":"_doc","_id":"iBzGbHcB1FB4PL8e-t_M","status":400,"error":{"type":"mapper_parsing_exception","reason":"unknown parameter [enabled] on mapper [kind] of type [null]"}}}
```
